paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar ben Dama: Jerusalem Talmud, Shabbat, end of chapter 14. Hyman says that in the Babylonian Talmud he is mentioned simply as Ben Dama; see that entry.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Guggenheimer Shabbat 14:4 paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Elazar ben Dama, supporting that local full title. The separate Babylonian Ben Dama pointer remains Hyman’s report and was not freshly collated for identity; the two designations are not bound to one person here.
